- x11 = ulcorner(x3): upper-left corner of the 2x2 square object.
- x12 = lbind(subtract, x11): function that subtracts x11 from a given point -> (point - x11).
- x13 = matcher(first, x4): check color equals x4.
- x14 = rbind(sfilter, x13): function that filters a container keeping cells with color x4.
- x15 = chain(x12, ulcorner, x14): (sfilter container by color x4) -> ulcorner -> subtract x11. So, relative offset of the top-left of the x4-colored cells in a container vs x11.
- x16 = fork(shift, identity, x15): shift(container, offset) where offset = x15(container).
- x17 = mapply(x16, x10): apply x16 to each of the 3 transformed copies, merge.
- x18 = paint(I, x17): paint onto I.
